messages.text: A and I both want the trailer in the next few weeks, and neither of us is backing down. B's pad is where it lives, so she is stuck in the middle. Can you help the three of us sort this out?

It’s been fine, though it is a bit in the way, so I’d be glad if we could sort out moving it sooner rather than later. I haven’t set a deadline, and I’d need my landlord’s approval for any change to what’s kept on the pad—I haven’t asked him yet.
I need it for weekend trips starting in the next few weeks; I don’t have exact dates or a firmer deadline. I don’t know how B feels about storing it.
I need it in the next few weeks for hauling materials on my home project. I don’t have exact dates, but I can’t just wait until A’s finished with it.

I’m not agreeing to wait until A’s finished. I need the first slot we can pin down in the next few weeks to haul materials. Then we can schedule A’s trips; alternating weekends only works if my hauling fits one weekend.
I can’t name a specific weekend yet. I need a hauling slot in the next few weeks; that doesn’t mean I need the trailer until my whole project is done.
I can work out the order directly with C. Alternate weekends could work, but I need access for my trips in the next few weeks. I’m not proposing any changes to B’s pad.

That sounds workable, though I’d be glad if it could be moved off my pad sooner rather than later. I don’t have a particular window when it can’t be there—just let me know once you’ve settled the dates.
Yes, C can go first. I’m okay with the weekend right after she hands it back.
Yes. C goes first, then I get the weekend after she hands it back. Alternate weekends after that are fine if needed; let’s set dates once she knows her materials date.
That works as a scheduling plan. I’ll message A and copy you and B once I have my hauling weekend.
Thanks for letting me know. I appreciate you sorting it out; I’ll look forward to hearing the dates, and hope it can be moved off my pad before too long.
